optical.label: Property
optical.text: ISO brightness

optical.label: Public method scope
optical.text: ISO 2470-1:2016 measures diffuse blue reflectance for white and near-white pulp, paper and board.

optical.label: Context to retain
optical.text: Instrument illumination is adjusted to CIE illuminant C, including the specified UV basis.

optical.label: Property
optical.text: CIE whiteness, D65/10°

optical.label: Public method scope
optical.text: ISO 11475:2017 uses reflectance across the visible spectrum for paper and board viewed under the D65 daylight basis.

optical.label: Context to retain
optical.text: Results involving fluorescent whitening agents depend on the UV content described by the method.

optical.label: Property
optical.text: Paper colour, D65/10°

optical.label: Public method scope
optical.text: ISO 5631-2:2022 measures colour by diffuse reflectance with specular gloss eliminated.

optical.label: Context to retain
optical.text: Keep the stated illumination, observer and fluorescent-material conditions; L* is not another name for brightness.

optical.label: Property
optical.text: Paper-backing opacity

optical.label: Public method scope
optical.text: ISO 2471:2008 determines opacity by diffuse reflectance.

optical.label: Context to retain
optical.text: Keep backing and applicable UV/FWA conditions with the result.

evidence.label: Evidence role
evidence.text: Supplier-declared pigment information

evidence.label: What it can answer
evidence.text: What the supplier states for the identified product, method and document revision

evidence.label: Limit
evidence.text: It does not establish finished-paper performance.

evidence.label: Evidence role
evidence.text: System observation

evidence.label: What it can answer
evidence.text: What was observed about dispersion or agglomeration in the declared furnish and route

evidence.label: Limit
evidence.text: It does not prove a root cause by itself.

evidence.label: Evidence role
evidence.text: Retention-related observation

evidence.label: What it can answer
evidence.text: What was observed after the pigment entered the system

evidence.label: Limit
evidence.text: It does not create an unmeasured retention percentage.

evidence.label: Evidence role
evidence.text: Finished-paper result

evidence.label: What it can answer
evidence.text: How the identified paper performed under a named method and condition

evidence.label: Limit
evidence.text: It applies to the declared furnish, construction, route and result basis.
